title: How To Deal With Toxic Coworkers (HR Approved Survival Guide)
description:
Check out my book: https://emilydurham.org/clock-in

Thanks for joining me today!

Think your coworker is sabotaging you? You’re probably right. In this video, we’re breaking down exactly how to outsmart toxic coworkers without losing your cool (or your job). This is the HR-approved guide to winning office politics, toxic co-workers and office mean girls. 

We cover:
- how to tell your co-worker is toxic (and not just annoying)
- how to protect yourseld
- when to escalate 

Let me know if you have any questions in my comments!
